subject: MAP Kickoff: Finovo Mutual Action Plan (draft)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Smith <j.smith@finovo.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Kickoff: Finovo Mutual Action Plan (draft)

Hi Jordan / Alyssa —

Thanks again for taking time this morning — really appreciate the clear context on your usage patterns and the regulatory constraints around PHI retention. Per our discovery, I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) to align on milestones, owners, and a target close date. High level summary below.

Key goals from our call:
- Integrate Redwood Private (VPC) for model inference to meet Finovo's PHI controls
- Pilot with 2 product teams (Clinical Search, Chart Summaries) on a 6-week evaluation
- Validate latency and cost targets at 50 concurrent users

Attached: 20260303-Finovo-MAP-draft.pdf (MAP draft with milestones + acceptance criteria)

Draft MAP (high level) — please review and confirm stakeholders:
1) Kickoff & architecture review — Owner: Finovo Eng lead / Marissa (Redwood) — Target: Mar 9–13
2) Sandbox access & test data provisioning — Owner: Finovo Security / Aditya (Redwood) — Target: Mar 16
3) Pilot deployment (2 features) — Owner: Finovo Product / Vivek (Redwood) — Target: Apr 6
4) Acceptance & performance validation — Owner: Finovo Eng / Marissa — Target close: Apr 20

Dependencies we flagged:
- Network/VPC peering and KMS access (Finovo infra team)
- Test data scrubbed/mapped to the sandbox schema
- PO sign-off on pilot success criteria (latency < 300ms p95, cost per 1k tokens)

Timeline options (pick one):
A) Aggressive: 6 weeks pilot — target close Apr 20 (recommended if infra sign-off is quick)
B) Conservative: 10 weeks — target close May 4 (if infra takes longer or additional security review needed)

Ask: can you confirm the primary internal stakeholders for each milestone (eng lead, security owner, product PO) and whether the team prefers Option A or B for timeline? Once you confirm, we’ll turn this draft into a shared MAP in HubSpot and schedule the kickoff (30–45m).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick sync if that helps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: 20260303-Finovo-MAP-draft.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)
From: Jordan Smith <j.smith@finovo.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@finovo.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Finovo Mutual Action Plan (draft)

Marissa —

Appreciate the thorough recap and the draft MAP. Quick answers/clarifications from our side:
- Stakeholders: Eng lead = Priya Natarajan (priya.n@finovo.com), Security owner = Nikhil Sharma (n.k@finovo.com), Product PO = Laura Bennett (laura.b@finovo.com). I’ve looped Alyssa to coordinate schedules.
- We have a mandatory internal security review that typically takes 2–3 weeks; that pushes us toward your Option B unless we can fast-track a subset of checks for the sandbox.

Couple of asks on the draft:
1) Can you break out the pilot acceptance criteria into functional vs. non-functional (we want explicit pass/fail checks for latency and PHI handling)
2) For the sandbox access step, we need a short template of the network information Redwood will need to provision peering (IP ranges, KMS flow).

If you can incorporate those edits, we can confirm stakeholders and set a kickoff date. Prefer a kickoff on the week of Mar 23 or Mar 30 — we’ll know more after the security team syncs tomorrow.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, Product Engineering
Finovo
j.smith@finovo.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Smith <j.smith@finovo.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@finovo.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 13:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Finovo Mutual Action Plan (draft)

Jordan — thanks, that list of stakeholders is perfect. I’ve updated the MAP draft per your asks and attached an updated PDF (same filename; v2). Summary of changes below (please review the attached page 2 for acceptance criteria table):

- Acceptance criteria: split into functional (correctness, edge-case handling for chart summaries) and non-functional (latency p95 < 300ms, cost per 1k tokens threshold, PHI redaction/retention checks). Each criterion has a pass/fail column and owner.
- Sandbox/network checklist: added required info for peering (CIDR ranges, expected egress rules) and KMS key policy example for your infra team to review.
- Adjusted timeline: given the security review note, I’ve proposed two kickoff windows — Mar 23 and Mar 30 — and set Option B as the default.

Updated Draft MAP (high level milestones & owners):
1) Kickoff & architecture review — Owner: Priya Natarajan (Finovo) / Marissa Cole (Redwood) — Target: week Mar 23 or Mar 30
2) Security review & sandbox setup — Owner: Nikhil Sharma (Finovo) / Aditya Rao (Redwood) — Target: 2–3 weeks after kickoff
3) Pilot deployment (Clinical Search + Chart Summaries) — Owner: Laura Bennett (Finovo) / Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood) — Target: 3 weeks after sandbox ready
4) Acceptance & performance validation — Owner: Finovo Eng / Marissa — Target close: 4 weeks after pilot start (approx May 4 if we pick Option B)

Next steps from Redwood:
- I’ll upload the MAP to HubSpot and share the editable link (copying into the related_links field).
- Aditya will provide the exact peering/KMS template by EOD tomorrow.

Can you confirm: 1) preferred kickoff week (Mar 23 vs Mar 30), 2) any additional stakeholders we should include (legal/compliance), and 3) whether Option B (May 4 target close) works for you?

If it helps, I’m available for a 20m sync on Wed at 10am PT to run through the MAP.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: 20260303-Finovo-MAP-draft.pdf (PDF v2, 3 pages)
From: Jordan Smith <j.smith@finovo.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@finovo.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.n@finovo.com>, Nikhil Sharma <n.k@finovo.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.b@finovo.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 15:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Finovo Mutual Action Plan (draft)

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the updated draft — looks good. We’ll target the week of Mar 30 for kickoff (security team is asking for that buffer). Option B and the May 4 target close works for our planning.

I’ll loop in Legal if anything shows up in the security review that requires contract changes, but for now we’re good to proceed. Please go ahead and post the MAP in HubSpot and send the peering/KMS template; I’ll get back to you after the security sync tomorrow.

Appreciate it — Jordan
